reason: Adds an image-understanding bridge for text-first DeepSeek Harness models by sending selected session or workspace images to configurable external vision APIs and returning bounded text analysis.

summaries.zh: 为文本优先的 DeepSeek Harness 模型提供图像理解桥接，将会话或工作区图像发送到可配置的视觉 API 并返回文本分析。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding to text-first DeepSeek Harness models by sending selected session or workspace images to configurable vision APIs and returning text analysis.

capabilities: Sends attached or workspace image bytes to a configured HTTPS vision provider
Calls Gemini-native, OpenAI-compatible, or Anthropic-compatible vision APIs
Reads explicitly selected workspace images through Harness attachment and filesystem services
Stores and manages provider credentials through Harness credential services
Adds a per-model vision toggle and provider configuration UI
